planner_input_view.transform: build_planner_evaluation_views applies authoritative state normalization, injects the prior semantic-stage capability group, removes boundary-only fields, rotates fact/asset order, and reassigns opaque IDs

limitations: These are synthetic contract and rule smoke cases, not observed successful campaign pages.
The same cases must not be used as final orchestration holdout data.
Every case has exactly eight facts and one fact per capability group; this regularity is unsuitable for semantic normalization evaluation.
Natural-language paraphrase diversity is limited and does not establish model generalization.
A separate 64-case semantic normalization set with variable fact counts, ordering, paraphrases, distractors, and repeated groups is still required.
Planner-state normalization and capability-group assignment are inputs to this rule set, not LLM quality metrics.
Template IDs are excluded because this smoke set has no real section-order or placement labels; template-aware quality requires the orchestration holdout.
Input-only logical diversity is 59 signatures for product variants and 28 for defensive cases; expected labels are deliberately excluded from this calculation.
Persuasion goals, grouping keys, section order, final media kind, and exact placement are outside this smoke set.
The approved worker projection boundary is specified but has not yet been added to the runtime dispatcher.
Human image and rendered HTML quality evaluation remains separate.
